content:
Liz (Finance): OrbitalHealth flagged invoice INV-8921 — theres a dedicated commit line but also a separate cross-region burst charge of ~120k tokens on 2026-03-14. Can we reconcile and confirm whether this is billable to the customer or if we should issue an SLA credit?
Sam (Sales): Customer says their EU cluster failed over to US and they were charged for burst usage. Very unhappy. Please confirm root cause and whether this was our routing policy.
Anita (Eng Infra): Looking into it now. Quick summary: during a scheduled maintenance in eu-1, our smart-router routed some pinned requests to us-west fallback for a handful of dedicated pools. For customers without pinned regional-only policies, fallback is allowed. That triggered shared-burst metering on the US side.
Anita (Eng Infra): Pasting meter lines we see:
```
metric: dedicated_burst.tokens
customer: orbitalhealth
period: 2026-03-14T02:20Z - 2026-03-14T03:05Z
value: 120345
route: us-west-2
cause: eu-1-maintenance -> fallback
```
Raj (Billing): Invoice snippet:
```
INV-8921
reserved_commit: 1,200,000 tokens @ committed rate
lineitem: cross_region_shared_burst 120,345 tokens @ $0.0009 = $108.31
```
Maya (Support): Customer quote: "We didn't authorize cross-region billing for dedicated capacity — we expected capacity to be reserved for us in EU or fail closed." They want full reversal of the burst charge unless we can justify.
Liz (Finance): Per contract (SOW section 4.2) we have a clause about cross-region fallback but its ambiguous. Two options: 1) Bill customer the burst charge (they used capacity) or 2) Credit the burst charge plus an SLA goodwill credit because the failover behavior wasn't communicated. Legal prefers option 2 for retention. Need decision and approval.
Sam (Sales): Recommend option 2 — issue full reversal of the $108.31 burst line and an extra goodwill credit of $50. Customer retention risk if we push.
Anita (Eng Infra): We accept responsibility for not surfacing fallback routing in the console or onboarding docs. Engineering recommends a config flag to opt out of cross-region fallback for dedicated pools; ETA 2 weeks.
Raj (Billing): For accounting: if we credit $158.31 total, I need a GL code and an approval note. Suggest using "Customer Credits - Operations". Also confirm whether we should rollback the charge on the invoice or apply a separate credit memo.
Liz (Finance): Approve credit memo for $158.31. GL: CUST_CR_OPS_01. Please add a short explanation: "Credit issued for cross-region burst during maintenance; customer-presumed regional-only dedicated capacity."
Maya (Support): I'll notify OrbitalHealth and send a conciliatory note. Can we commit to the engineering fix and a follow-up by next Wed?
Anita (Eng Infra): Yes — we'll deliver an opt-out flag for cross-region fallback and a short doc. I'll post an RFC in eng-infra after this thread.
Liz (Finance): I'll process the credit memo and confirm once posted. Raj please queue the credit; Sam/Maya coordinate messaging.
DeployBot: rollout:eu-maintenance -> noted. No further automated billing actions.
Sam (Sales): Thanks all. I'll hold off on formal response until the credit is posted.
Liz (Finance): Credit approved and queued. Will update thread with credit memo ID once posted."
